_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Michael L. Rodkinson (1845-1904). His English translation of the Babylonian Talmud, the sections Moed (Festivals) and Jurisprudence (Damages), in the second edition, 're-edited, revised and enlarged' (Boston, The Talmud Society, 1918; first edition New York, 1896-1903): eighteen volumes of translation. Rodkinson's own History of the Talmud (the set's vols XIX-XX) is not a translation and is left out. Gorfinkle's Pirke Avot and Ginzberg's Legends of the Jews are on their own shelves. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 86); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
